The question asked you to name the sampling method, which means matching the plan's key feature to its definition. Here the trees respond only after seeing a report, so participation is self-selected. That is what makes a sample voluntary response, not simple random sampling.

You chose C, SRS, because any tree could have ended up in the group. That reasoning misses the point. In an SRS, every individual and every possible sample of that size has an equal chance of selection, and the selection is made by the researcher using randomization. Here the trees choose themselves, so the chance of inclusion is not controlled by any random process.

Next move: for each choice, ask who decides who is in the sample. If the researcher picks at random, it may be SRS. If the individuals decide to take part, it is voluntary response.
